About this build

EPA is computed from the real cfbfastR/sportsdataverse-py ep_model.ubj expected-points model (XGBoost, multi:softprob, 7-class next-score target), ported tree-for-tree into this page — verified against the model's own predictions on random test states (max probability deviation ~7e-7). Nothing is approximated on the down/distance/field-position/time/score axis.

Simplification: on turnover / punt / missed-FG / turnover-on-downs plays, the "after" state's clock is carried over from the snap rather than adjusted for run-off, since that has a small effect on EPA outside two-minute situations. Overtime plays are outside the model's trained domain (period ≤ 4) and are scored with time-remaining set to 0 as an approximation.
